source_name: CobbParcels current countywide parcel service - parcel identifier projection only
authority_basis: Official Cobb County ArcGIS organization and Cobb County Tax Assessor/GIS distribution policy

legal_scope.rationale: Cobb County explicitly distributes countywide Tax Assessor tabular parcel data at no cost through its GIS distribution channel. Cobb separately prices digital tax-assessor GIS parcel polygon data. BridgePoint therefore limits this candidate to factual parcel identifiers only and does not infer geometry rights from public FeatureServer visibility.
legal_scope.important_restriction: This manifest does not itself approve reuse. Production ingestion must fail closed unless the live BridgePoint compliance engine accepts the exact parcel-ID-only projection. Geometry must remain disabled unless separately approved under a geometry-specific rights decision.
